name: @pipeworx/mcp-sunrisesunset

tools.name: get_times
tools.description: Get today's sunrise, sunset, dawn, dusk, solar noon, golden hour, and day length for a given latitude and longitude. Returns all times in the location's local timezone.

tools.name: get_times_date
tools.description: Get sunrise, sunset, dawn, dusk, solar noon, and golden hour times for a specific date at a location.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-sunrisesunset forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the sunrisesunset pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
